LAW AND MOTION, 301, RULING - ATTY. RAMCHANDANI INFORMED THE COURT THAT THE MOVING PARTY CALLED TAKING THE MATTER OFF-CALENDAR IN A TIMELY MANNER. THEY WERE ALSO NOT SERVED WITH THE FIRST AMENDED COMPLAINT. A SECOND AMENDED COMPLAINT WAS ALSO SERVED ON HER WITHOUT ANY LEAVE OF COURT. DEFENDANT MERCER (US) INCORPORATED'S DEMURRER TO 1ST AMENDED COMPLAINT IS TAKEN OFF-CALENDAR BY THE COURT. THE FIRST AMENDED COMPLAINT IS THE OPERATIVE COMPLAINT AND THE PARTIES WERE ENCOURAGED TO TALK TO EACH OTHER TO AVOID UNNECCESARY ROUND OF MOTIONS. DEFENDANT'S COUNSEL IS DIRECTED TO READ AND COMPLY WITH LOCAL RULE 2.6 (C). JUDGE: PETER J. BUSCH, REPORTER: CAROL KAREN, CSR # 8189 301/PJB

LAW AND MOTION 301, RULING - THE COURT ADOPTED ITS TENTATIVE RULING AS FOLLOWS: DEFENDANT MERCER (US) INCORPORATED'S DEMURRER TO 2ND AMENDED COMPLAINT IS SUSTAINED WITHOUT LEAVE TO AMEND AS TO CAUSES OF ACTION 1, 2 AND 4. THE STATUTE OF LIMITATIONS WAS NOT TOLLED BY PLAINTIFF'S FAILURE TO CONFORM WITH C R C RESULTING IN THE REQUIRED REJECTION OF HIS PLEADING FOR FILING. PERFORMANCE WAS NOT IMPOSSIBLE, AND PLAINTIFF'S FAILURE WAS DUE ENTIRELY TO HIS OWN LACK OF DILIGENCE AND FAILURE TO FOLLOW THE RULES. AS TO CAUSE OF ACTION 3, THE MOTION IS TREATED AS A MOTION TO STRIKE AND GRANTED BECAUSE LEAVE WAS NOT GIVEN TO ADD A NEW CAUSE OF ACTION. MOVING PARTY IS TO SUBMIT A PROPOSED FORM OF ORDER. JUDGE: PETER J. BUSCH, REPORTER: CAROL KAREN, CSR # 8189 301/PJB
